title: CAN transmit allowlist
description: A pack's can.tx_allowlist (CanLink spec §7, ADR-0020): every frame beyond the Tier 0 diagnostic reads that a pack may ever transmit on a vehicle bus. A frame is sent only when an entry matches, the driving state is in the entry's states (default Parked; never Moving) and the gate holds a short-lived single-use grant for the entry's action and tier. Tier 4 is never listed (it needs its own ADR). $defs.transport is the pack's CAN transport declaration (vehicle.json transport), which skips bitrate detection (ADR-0023); the pack vehicle.json schema references it when it lands.

bus.description: Which bus of the vehicle (the OBD port is "obd").

id.description: CAN id in hex: 3 digits for 11-bit, 8 digits for 29-bit.

data.description: Spaced hex of the leading data bytes, with xx wildcards ("02 01 04").

action.description: The pack action this frame belongs to; a grant names it.

tier.description: The action's safety tier (Tier 0 reads need no entry; Tier 4 needs an ADR).

category.description: The ADR-0033 action category, for the manifest.
